title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling until you are exhausted.
body:
We decided to build the opposite. At Headlinne, our philosophy is simple. We believe news should inform you, not overwhelm you. The current model of the internet is designed to capture your attention at any cost, often by prioritizing noise over substance.

We use AI differently. Instead of creating a feed that feeds on your anxiety, we use technology to filter out the clutter. We focus on the core facts and the context that actually matters to your day. You should not have to sift through ten different articles to understand one major event.

When you remove the need for constant engagement, the experience becomes much calmer. You get the information you need, you understand the world a little better, and then you can get back to your life. That is what a smart news experience looks like to us.
cta: If you are ready for a better way to stay informed, you can explore our approach at HEADLINNE.com.
